_help: Your group fills this in. Nothing here is fixed: rename the fields, add or remove them, and leave 'values' empty for an open field the model may answer freely. extraction.py builds the schema, the prompts and the human-label template from this file.
subtopic: AI-assisted immigration & refugee law case research (Australian Federal Court opinions, precedent identification and citation treatment)

visa_category.description: the type of immigration/visa matter the case concerns (e.g. protection/refugee visa, partner/family visa, skilled/business visa, student visa, visa cancellation, citizenship)

citation_treatment.description: how this case treats the precedent(s) it cites, matching the class values used by the source dataset

cited_cases.description: case names/citations referenced in the opinion, copied exactly as written
